newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber stable in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber stable in thin trading.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in thin late trading on Tuesday on the back of slow U.S. demand, dealers said.
"Demand from the United States, Indonesia's main rubber buyer, remains very slow on the back of possible higher stock," one dealer in Jakarta said.
Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November were at 55.00-55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 54.75-55.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.50-55.00 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Dealers said U.S. firms were last heard buying SIR20 late on Monday at 54.75 cents/lb fob Padang November shipments, down from the previous 55.00 cents.
Another Jakarta-based dealer said he expected SIR3L to firm up in the coming days due to expected higher demand.
"Offer prices for the shoe-grade SIR3L were last at 132 cents/kg and were likely to edge up to around 134 cents due expected higher demand from Japan," he said.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in the local markets of Bandung and Tangerang, they said.
